record.question: Which of the following is the correct order of the OSI model layers (bottom to top)?
options: Application, Transport, Session, Network, Data Link, Physical, Presentation
Physical, Data Link, Network, Transport, Session, Presentation, Application
Physical, Data Link, Network, Session, Transport, Presentation, Application
Transport, Network, Session, Physical, Data Link, Application, Presentation
record.explanation: Bottom to top is Physical, Data Link, Network, Transport, Session, Presentation, Application. Verified solution (unofficial); reviewed 26 October 2026. References: https://www.cisco.com/c/dam/en/us/products/collateral/switches/catalyst-2950-series-switches/prod_white_paper0900aecd8013313e.pdf
